rules.name: Mara leaves if no storm night

log.asked:
Task: A story: Mara keeps a lighthouse with her brother Tev. Tev hides a letter offering Mara a job in the city. A storm comes; Tev fails to light the lamp and a boat is nearly lost; Mara lights it. Mara finds the letter. Ending: Mara stays, because she has seen Tev cannot keep the light alone. If she had not seen the storm night, finding the letter would have made her leave.

Things and states to use:
  mara: at lighthouse, gone to city, staying for good
  lamp: dark, lit
Events to use: storm, mara lights lamp, mara finds letter

The checker will test your model on these jobs:
- "the story as told": events in order: storm, then mara lights lamp, then mara finds letter; expected at the end: mara is staying for good.
- "no storm night": events in order: mara finds letter; expected at the end: mara is gone to city.
- "letter never found": events in order: storm, then mara lights lamp; expected at the end: mara is at lighthouse.

Write the model.
log.replied: {"things": {"mara": ["at lighthouse", "gone to city", "staying for good"], "lamp": ["dark", "lit"], "storm_night": ["unseen", "seen"]}, "events": ["storm", "mara lights lamp", "mara finds letter"], "start": {"mara": "at lighthouse", "lamp": "dark", "storm_night": "unseen"}, "rules": [{"name": "storm night seen", "when": ["storm happens"], "then": "storm_night is seen"}, {"name": "Mara lights the lamp", "when": ["mara lights lamp happens"], "then": "lamp is lit"}, {"name": "Mara leaves if no storm night", "when": ["mara finds letter happens", "storm_night is unseen"], "then": "mara is gone to city"}, {"name": "Mara stays after storm night", "when": ["mara finds letter happens", "storm_night is seen"], "then": "mara is staying for good"}]}
